stages.label: Seedling

stages.label: Vegetative

Monitor early pest/disease symptoms and act early.

stages.label: Flowering/Fruiting
tips: Avoid moisture stress during flowering/fruiting.
Support pollination and watch for pests.
Apply recommended top dressing if needed.

stages.label: Harvest
tips: Harvest at proper maturity for quality produce.
Handle carefully to reduce damage.
Sort and store properly after harvest.

crops.name: Rice (Paddy)
crops.description: Staple cereal crop grown in irrigated and rainfed systems.
crops.season: Kharif (Jun–Nov) and Rabi in irrigated areas
crops.soil: Clayey loam with good water retention
crops.irrigation: Maintain shallow water; drainage near maturity

stages.label: Seedling
tips: Use younger seedlings (about 15 days) for SRI transplanting.
Maintain soil just moist during the first 10 days after transplanting.
Square planting helps weeding and aeration.

stages.label: Vegetative
tips: Follow alternate wetting and drying as recommended in SRI.
Restore irrigation after hairline cracks until panicle initiation.
Use cono/rotary weeder at 7–10 day intervals to manage weeds.

stages.label: Flowering/Fruiting
tips: Avoid moisture stress during flowering/fruiting.
Support pollination and watch for pests.
Apply recommended top dressing if needed.

stages.label: Harvest
tips: Harvest at proper maturity for quality produce.
Handle carefully to reduce damage.
Sort and store properly after harvest.
